facts.fact: 咖啡馆重逢：她主动拥抱，闻到他的古龙水立刻后悔——旧火复燃。
facts.anchor: “Hi, Sean.” I awkwardly go in for a hug. It seemed like the right thing to do, but I immediately regret it when I smell his cologne.

facts.fact: 她观察出 Sean 现在的状态：满足但不快乐。
facts.anchor: He seems to be content—but not happy. I always thought those two had to coexist.

facts.fact: Sean 的妹妹 Bailey 已婚有娃、在家教育女儿，古董店由他撑了一年。
facts.anchor: Yeah, she’s got the whole package deal. Husband. Kids. Big house.

facts.fact: Sean 邀她同行去父母的小屋（cabin），她挣扎后答应今晚出发。
facts.anchor: “I was planning a trip to the cabin,” he says. “You should come with me.”

facts.fact: 车程坦白：她六年前结过婚（Graham）。
facts.anchor: I got married six years ago.

facts.fact: 离婚真相：他离开她；戒指在法院签字后已卖掉。
facts.anchor: “Divorced.” I point at the empty finger, his eyes still on it. My pulse is a jackhammer in my ears. “He left me,” I blurt out.

facts.fact: Sean 交底：她是唯一爱过的人，等了十年。
facts.anchor: “You are the only person I have ever loved. I held out hope for you. Now it’s been 10 years,”

facts.fact: 篝火争执：她爆发——他说爱她却丢下她；他反问「就算留下，你会跟我在一起吗」。
facts.anchor: “Maybe it’s the fact that you told me that you loved me and then you left.

facts.fact: 和解：他原谅她很久了；她承认当年自私、没说出无法接受异地。
facts.anchor: “I should have just told you the truth. That I couldn’t deal with the distance. I was selfish.”

facts.fact: 小屋过夜她彻夜未眠、谎称睡得好；次日计划沿河散步。
facts.anchor: I barely slept a wink last night.
